Thanks for the details, Stephanie. Quick answers from finance: 

- Spend cap: Our current NW regional events bucket allows up to $30k per event without exec approval, so $21,600 is within policy. No additional director sign-off required.
- GL / Cost center: Please use Cost Center 4012 (Field Marketing - West) and GL account 6203 (Marketing Events).
- Deposit: We prefer a PO for vendor deposits over $5k. Please generate a PO referencing the vendor and line items; AP will hold the deposit until the invoice is matched.
- Speaker stipends: These should be issued to BrightWave as a separate line item on the vendor invoice if BrightWave will issue 1099s; otherwise, if paying individuals directly we need name/email and W-9s for each speaker (we do not want to create 1099s for the vendor unless they confirm).

DocuSign PO template: https://docusign.com/redsigned/abcd1234
Finance ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/FIN-2231
